scope: Candidate evidence mapping only; file presence is not scientific verification or applicability proof.

groups.check: Bind reference/measured IQ, correction procedure and plane. Receiver EVM is not transmitter RF conformance.
Wire actual waveform measurement with assigned/upper/lower adjacent filtered powers, offsets, bandwidth, sampling support and measurement window.
Retain waveform block identity, peak/mean power, oversampling, CP/filter policy and empirical block CCDF.
Select exact physical channel and first attempts; retain compared-bit/error counts and truth comparison independently of CRC. No pooling of first/retransmissions or different payloads.
Join unique TB identities and actual feedback; include abandoned blocks, deadlines and right-censored blocks separately.
Deduplicate useful delivered payload at the declared layer; divide by full observation time, retain zero-throughput users and failures.
Separate UE measurement from decoded gNB report; retain codebook/resource identity, observation/delivery/use clocks and corrupted or stale reports.
Validate resource masks, linear powers, antenna branch and bandwidth; normalized fixed-Es/N0 powers are not absolute watts/dBm; selected-PMI objective is not reference SINR.
Validate SSS/reference resource selection and RSSI window, branch combining and units; SSB-window power is not automatically NR carrier RSSI.
Separate payload types/widths; score actual bits, NACK-conditioned and absent-feedback occasion denominators; received DTX on a transmitted waveform is not a noise-only trial.
Select the requested channel; require independent signal-present/absent campaigns and occasion identities. Search-candidate counts are not empty-occasion denominators.
Use completed access procedures, not preamble detection; join retries/deadlines and distinguish multi-carrier experiment from single-cell access.
Use same-domain estimated and physical reference channel tensors; retain error/reference energy sums and explicit port pairs. Pilot residual is not channel NMSE.
Requires UE cross-link-interference resources and an interfering transmitter. gNB SRS measurements cannot substitute for UE CLI measurements.
Compare true offset with applied correction at the same reference/time; retain failed acquisition and cycle slips, not only successful residual estimates.
Count unions of exact subcarrier-symbol coordinates; separate actual occupancy from reservation and spatial ports; PRB-symbol totals alone are insufficient.
Join intended eligible occasions to receive outcomes; separate capacity, timing, collision and policy rejection; do not multiply marginal stage probabilities.
Energy is model-derived, not measured hardware energy. Retain state durations/powers/transitions; normalized waveform power is not conducted dBm without calibration.
Instrument actual elementary operations with a defined counting convention; decoder iterations and wall-clock latency do not establish operation count.
Requires agenda-specific event population, service criterion, reservation/procedure identity and censoring. A generic static AWGN run is not this experiment.
